responsibility: This is the central SPARC target header that defines the backend’s compile-time configuration macros, ABI and architecture-selection rules, register naming and assembler conventions, default CPU and code-model policy, TLS defaults, memory-model defaults, and many target macros used by generic GCC code and SPARC-specific md files. It provides the foundational interface and policy layer that OS-specific headers override or extend for particular SPARC environments.
same_name_distinction: This is the main SPARC target header of macro definitions, target constants, ABI/architecture policy, and assembler conventions, unlike sparc.cc which implements behavior, sparc.md which describes RTL patterns, and sparc.opt which defines user-visible target options.
